text:
Life, my life, let yourself fall, let yourself ache, my life,
+
+let yourself be entwined with fire, with innocent silence, with
+
+green stones in the house of night, let yourself
+
+fall and ache, my life.

translation.title: Life, My Life, Let Yourself Fall, Let Yourself Ache…
translation.editorial_note: Reuses a reviewed translation of the identical source body.
